description: Error/correction signal → skill recommendation mapping. v1.1: domain_globs context matching + auto-derived confidence by evidence_count (<3 low / 3-4 medium / ≥5 high). Independently implemented (inspired by accidentalrebel/claude-skill-session-retrospective concept).

mappings._comment: CSR #1037: dedicated mapping so verification-before-completion produces its OWN error_signal record (criterion #1) instead of borrowing systematic-debugging's /tests/ path token via cross-gate substring. Tokens key on test failure OUTCOME (not path PRESENCE), each anchored to a RUNNER-SPECIFIC FINGERPRINT string rather than a generic word (per Sentry/OTel grounding: route on producer-distinctive output, not arbitrary body substring): 'AssertionError' (pytest/python/java), '--- FAIL' (go), 'Failure/Error' (rspec exact failure block), 'test result: FAILED' (cargo/rust), 'expect(received' (jest/vitest/mocha assertion), 'test failed' (explicit). DELIBERATELY EXCLUDES generic words 'failure'/'failed'/'failures'/'failures:'/'Tests:' — even substring-of-line forms match infra errors ('authentication failure', 'lint failed: 3 failures:', 'validation failures:', 'make: see Tests:') and blow the FP budget (CSR #1037 deep-verify measured failures:/Tests: at FP 6/22; runner-fingerprint set at 0/22). NOTE: matching runs ONLY on is_error=True tool outputs (jsonl_analyzer L117), so the domain is already pre-filtered to failed commands. TOKEN OWNERSHIP: tuned against tests/test_csr1037_verification_mapping.py — recall covers DA-named runners pytest/go/rspec/cargo/jest + vitest; FP=0 on a combined realistic+adversarial non-test failure corpus. Extend ONLY with a matching recall fixture AND an FP re-measure. HONEST: precision improvement, NOT a completion-context solution (see CSR #1039 follow-up).
